# sharepoint-group-trim API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Advisory content branches selected by direct SharePoint site-group membership.

## GroupTrim

Mounts protected content after current-user direct membership matches all/any
selected SharePoint groups. Resolves selected-web user ID and every reference;
missing/ambiguous groups, malformed payloads and failed reads select ErrorFallback.
Does not expand Entra principals inside site groups. Requires the matching SPFx
provider/native SPHttpClient. Grants are advisory; server access still applies.
Requests share only while inflight within one provider; identity changes hide
former grants synchronously. No wrapper or inactive consumer mounting.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Throws

- Missing matching SPFx provider.

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<SharePointGroupTrim groups={[{ name: 'Project Readers' }]}>
  <section>Project</section>
  <SharePointGroupTrim.Loading>Checking</SharePointGroupTrim.Loading>
  <SharePointGroupTrim.Fallback>No membership</SharePointGroupTrim.Fallback>
  <SharePointGroupTrim.ErrorFallback>Unavailable</SharePointGroupTrim.ErrorFallback>
</SharePointGroupTrim>
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: SharePointGroupTrimProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: Nonempty ID/name selectors, optional web/match and structural children.

#### Returns

Active branch/content in a React fragment; omitted content is empty.

## SharePointGroupTrim

Headless direct SharePoint-group trim using a matching SPFx provider/native
SPHttpClient. Resolves every selector and the selected web's current user ID;
Entra principals are not expanded. webUrl defaults to current web, match to all;
any accepts one group only after all reads succeed. Only protected or one unique
direct family branch mounts; omitted content is empty. No wrapper/styles/callbacks.
Requests deduplicate inflight per provider only; changed identity masks old grants.
Server authorization remains required.

### Imports

```ts
import { SharePointGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SharePointGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { SharePointGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/sharepoint-group-trim';
```

### Use when

- Direct membership in specific SharePoint site groups should select advisory content branches.

### Avoid when

- Use EntraGroupTrim for directory groups; SharePoint groups do not expand contained Entra principals.

### Throws (2)

- Missing matching SPFx provider.

### Examples (2)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<SharePointGroupTrim groups={[{ name: 'Readers' }]}>
  Team content
  <SharePointGroupTrim.Fallback>No membership</SharePointGroupTrim.Fallback>
</SharePointGroupTrim>
```

### Signatures (2)

## SharePointGroupSelector

Exactly one SharePoint site-group reference. IDs are positive Int32 numbers;
names are exact, nonblank titles. Ambiguous/missing references are errors.

### Imports (5)

```ts
import type { SharePointGroupSelector } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SharePointGroupSelector } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { SharePointGroupSelector } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/sharepoint-group-trim';
```

### Examples (10)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointGroupSelector, SharePointGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const group: SharePointGroupSelector = { name: 'Project Readers' };
<SharePointGroupTrim groups={[group]}>Project</SharePointGroupTrim>;
```

### Type (4)

```ts
type SharePointGroupSelector = | {
      /**
       * Positive Int32 site-group ID.
       */ readonly id: number;
      /**
       * Excluded when selecting by ID.
       * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
       */ readonly name?: never;
    }
  | {
      /**
       * Exact nonblank group title.
       */ readonly name: string;
      /**
       * Excluded when selecting by name.
       * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
       */ readonly id?: never;
    }
```

## SharePointGroupTrimBranchProps

Structural SharePoint-group branch content; no DOM/style/ref props or wrapper.
Changing the active branch or its React marker key remounts its content;
unchanged branch/key rerenders preserve consumer state and child keys.

### Imports (6)

```ts
import type { SharePointGroupTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SharePointGroupTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { SharePointGroupTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/sharepoint-group-trim';
```

### Examples (11)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointGroupTrim, SharePointGroupTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const branch: SharePointGroupTrimBranchProps = { children: 'Checking groups' };
<SharePointGroupTrim groups={[{ name: 'Project Readers' }]}>
  <SharePointGroupTrim.Loading {...branch} />;
</SharePointGroupTrim>
```

### Members (6)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SharePointGroupTrimBranchProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional, readonly | — | Optional active branch children. When omitted, renders empty; ReactNode preserves legacy null input. |

## SharePointGroupTrimProps

Current-user direct SharePoint group membership beneath a matching SPFx
provider. Remote-web current user is resolved in that web's site collection.
Entra principals contained in a SharePoint group are not expanded.

### Imports (7)

```ts
import type { SharePointGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SharePointGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { SharePointGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/sharepoint-group-trim';
```

### Examples (12)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointGroupTrim, SharePointGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const props: SharePointGroupTrimProps = { groups: [{ id: 5 }], match: 'any' };
<SharePointGroupTrim {...props}>Team content</SharePointGroupTrim>;
```

### Members (7)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SharePointGroupTrimProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional, readonly | — | Protected content and unique direct family branches. Inactive content never mounts; when omitted, renders empty. ReactNode preserves legacy null input. |
| `SharePointGroupTrimProps.groups` | `readonly SharePointGroupSelector[]` | Required, readonly | — | Required nonempty ID/name selectors; all must resolve successfully before any decision. |
| `SharePointGroupTrimProps.match` | `"all" \| "any" \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | 'all' | all (when omitted) requires direct membership in every selected group; any requires one. |
| `SharePointGroupTrimProps.webUrl` | `string \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | — | Absolute HTTP(S) web URL without query/fragment; omitted uses current web. |
